question:
In a series LCR circuit, state:
(i) the condition required for resonance
(ii) how the impedance changes at resonance, with justification

options.A: At resonance, $X_L>X_C$ and the impedance is maximum.
options.B: At resonance, $X_C>X_L$ and the impedance is zero.
options.C:
(i) Resonance requires $X_L=X_C$.
(ii) Then $Z=\sqrt{R^2+(X_L-X_C)^2}=R$, the minimum impedance, because the reactances cancel.
